summary: A few neighbors speak against a plan at a public meeting and the builder comes back with a smaller project and more parking.
realLife: In a Cambridge, Massachusetts hearing described in a book excerpt, six neighbors objected and the developer paid for two studies, returned three months later and cut four units to three.
inGame: a cause a neighbor shares leads to an invitation to a posted town meeting; the meeting's outcome writes a changed plan.

turns.summary: The board approves the plan anyway.
turns.writesBack: neighbors disappointed; tie to the board colder

turns.summary: New neighbors turn out in favor and the board hears both sides.
turns.writesBack: agenda item on housing; ties across the town
